description: This PHP script manages the assignment of user roles to test projects and test plans within the TestLink test management system. It includes logic for initializing data, verifying user permissions, fetching effective roles, performing updates, and rendering the user interface for role management.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in TestLink, with methods for retrieving user details and roles.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: Represents roles in TestLink, with methods for checking rights and getting role colors.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns arguments needed for processing the page, including feature type, ID, user, and permissions.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has sufficient rights to access or modify user roles on a test project or plan.

methods.name: checkRightsForUpdate
methods.description: Checks if a user has rights to perform an update on user roles for a specific test project or plan.

methods.name: getTestProjectEffectiveRoles
methods.description: Retrieves the effective roles of users for a specific test project, considering user rights and accessibility.

methods.name: getTestPlanEffectiveRoles
methods.description: Retrieves the effective roles of users for a specific test plan within a test project.

methods.name: getTestPlanEffectiveRolesNEW
methods.description: An alternate implementation to retrieve user roles for test plans, with detailed logic for permissions and accessibility.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Performs the update of user roles based on submitted form data.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI configuration and state variables for role assignment pages.

methods.name: initLabels
methods.description: Initializes labels used for UI display messages related to role assignments.
